title: UPACapabilityTokenProfile
description: Un-encrypted internal JSON metadata configuration payload contained within an authorized UPA capability JWT token.

can_pay.description: Global execution bit status. Toggling to false invalidates all child agent outilined tool calls instantly.

max_single_amount.description: Absolute numeric transaction cap enforced natively by the inline SQL/Lua database locks.

currency_whitelist.description: Explicit whitelist of accepted transaction ISO currency codes.

counterparty_whitelist_identifiers.description: List of valid ERP supplier strings or merchant wallet strings allowed for transaction processing.

expires_timestamp.description: Hard chronological limits window. Past this timestamp, validation keys fail open-secure.

contextual_purpose_restrictions.description: Whitelisted ISO 20022 operational intent categories (e.g. COMP for cloud computing infrastructure, TRAD for commerce goods).
